summary: The blueprint broadly covers human pancreas compartments but needs targeted cleanup of the unsupported endocrine progenitor-like axis, beta maturation/stress labeling, and a few vascular/endocrine distinctions.

issues.description: Healthy human pancreas without developmental or injury notes should not require a true endocrine progenitor axis, and the current module mixes ductal/progenitor markers with endocrine and stress/dedifferentiation-associated genes.
issues.suggested_fix: Delete this axis/module, or replace it in place with a clearly named beta/endocrine dedifferentiation or stress-state module gated more narrowly by beta/endocrine identity and without SOX9/HES1-driven ductal signal.

issues.description: The negative immature_beta_like module contains several generic ER-stress and hypoxia/glycolysis genes, so beta_maturation can read as mature beta versus stressed/dedifferentiated beta rather than true maturation.
issues.suggested_fix: Either rename/reframe the axis as beta stress/dedifferentiation, or replace the negative genes with a cleaner immature/dedifferentiated beta set while keeping generic ER-stress genes in secretory_er_stress.

issues.description: The axis name implies endocrine versus all exocrine epithelium, but the negative side is acinar only and omits ductal/centroacinar epithelium.
issues.suggested_fix: Rename it to endocrine_vs_acinar, or introduce/use a broader exocrine_epithelium negative module that includes acinar plus ductal/centroacinar programs.

issues.description: The blueprint separates vascular from lymphatic endothelium, but does not resolve arterial, venous, and capillary/islet endothelial states expected in pancreas tissue.
issues.suggested_fix: Add one or two gated endothelial subtype axes if dimensionality permits, such as arterial endothelial versus venous/ACKR1-like and/or fenestrated/islet capillary endothelial within endothelial_core.

issues.description: The immune core includes LST1 and TYROBP, which are myeloid-skewed and make the general immune identity less neutral.
issues.suggested_fix: Keep pan-immune markers in immune_core and move strongly myeloid-skewed genes to macrophage_myeloid.

out_of_scope: The broad stress axes are acceptable as generic scRNA-seq state dimensions, but downstream users should not interpret them as pancreas-specific identity axes.
